一句话作用: Configure Turborepo for efficient monorepo builds with local and remote caching. Use when setting up Turborepo, optimizing build pipelines, or implementing distributed caching.
关键输入: - Setting up new Turborepo projects - Configuring build pipelines - Implementing remote caching - Optimizing CI/CD performance - Migrating from other monorepo tools - Debugging cache misses
解决具体问题: 当需要- Setting up new Turborepo projects - Configuring build pipelines - Implementing remote caching - Optimizing CI/CD performance - Migrating from other monorepo tools - Debugging cache misses时，用它产出或更新：turbo build --verbosity=2
